Job Title: Backend Engineer (Fresher Experienced)
Location: Hyderabad, Telangana
Company: Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd.
About Us:
Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd. (HUMS) is a dynamic and innovative company dedicated to revolutionizing the Healthcare Industry. We support Harmony United Psychiatric Care, a US-based Healthcare Company, by delivering technology-enabled healthcare management solutions. Our commitment to innovation, quality, and continuous improvement drives everything we do.
Position Overview:
We are looking for Backend Engineers (Freshers Experienced) to develop secure, scalable, and high-performance backend systems for our healthcare applications. The ideal candidate should have strong programming fundamentals and a passion for building reliable server-side applications.
Responsibilities:
Design, develop, test, and maintain backend applications, services, and RESTful APIs.
Build scalable and secure APIs and, where applicable, microservices.
Develop and optimize SQL/NoSQL databases, queries, schemas, and data access layers.
Implement business logic and backend workflows for healthcare applications.
Integrate third-party services, APIs, payment gateways, healthcare services, and other external systems.
Ensure backend applications meet requirements for security, performance, scalability, reliability, and data integrity.
Implement appropriate authentication, authorization, validation, error handling, and logging.
Collaborate with frontend developers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, and product teams.
Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve application and production issues.
Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-documented code.
Participate in code reviews and follow software development and coding best practices.
Develop and maintain unit and integration tests.
Optimize application performance, database queries, and API response times.
Maintain technical documentation, API documentation, and system-related documentation.
Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
For experienced engineers, contribute to backend architecture, technical design, scalability, and technical decision-making.

Requirements:
For Freshers
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Strong programming fundamentals in at least one backend language such as:
Java
C# / .NET
Python
Node.js / JavaScript
PHP, if applicable to your technology stack
Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and common programming concepts.
Basic understanding of REST APIs and HTTP/HTTPS.
Basic knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts.
Understanding of database tables, relationships, joins, indexes, and basic query optimization.
Basic knowledge of Git and version control.
Understanding of SDLC and software development practices.
Basic understanding of authentication, authorization, and application security is an advantage.
Familiarity with Docker and cloud platforms is an advantage.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Candidates with academic projects, internships, GitHub projects, or personal backend projects are encouraged to apply.


For Experienced Candidates
2-6 years of hands-on backend development experience.
Strong programming experience in one or more backend technologies such as Java, C#/.NET, Python, Node.js, or PHP.
Strong experience developing and maintaining RESTful APIs and backend services.
Good understanding of backend architecture, application design, and software development patterns.
Strong experience with SQL databases and database design.
Experience with SQL query optimization, indexing, transactions, and database performance tuning.
Experience integrating third-party APIs and external services.
Experience implementing authentication, authorization, validation, logging, and error handling.
Experience writing unit and integration tests.
Experience with Git and Agile/Scrum development practices.
Experience troubleshooting and resolving production issues.
Good understanding of application security and secure coding practices.
Experience with Docker and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is an advantage.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills
Backend: Java / Spring Boot, C# / .NET, Python / Django / FastAPI, Node.js / Express, PHP
API: REST / JSON / HTTP / Postman / OpenAPI/Swagger
Databases: MySQL / PostgreSQL / SQL Server / MongoDB
ORM/Data Access: Entity Framework / Hibernate / JPA / Sequelize / SQLAlchemy or similar
Testing: JUnit / NUnit / pytest / Jest or similar frameworks
Version Control: Git / GitHub / GitLab
Containers: Docker
Cloud: AWS / Azure / GCP
Caching: Redis or similar technologies
Messaging: RabbitMQ / Kafka or similar technologies
Architecture: Microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven architecture
Security: OAuth 2.0 / JWT / RBAC / secure API development
API Documentation: Swagger / OpenAPI
Familiarity with healthcare applications, EHR/EMR systems, medical billing, insurance, or healthcare workflows is an added advantage.
Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7/FHIR is an added advantage.
Experience working with applications requiring strong data privacy, security, and reliability is a plus.

Diversity, Equality, and Inclusion:
Diversity, equality, and inclusion are fundamental to our success at HUMS. We embrace diverse perspectives and provide equal opportunities for all employees.
Benefits:
Competitive salary (including EPF and PS)
Health insurance
Four days work-week (Monday - Thursday)
Opportunities for career growth and professional development
Additional benefits like food and cab-drop are available
Please submit your resume and cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you fit this role perfectly. We look forward to hearing from you!
For any queries, please reach out to [email protected]
Note: Available to take calls between 4:45 PM and 3:45 AM IST, Monday to Thursday only.

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

Job Summary

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on the SSCS Add-On team at GitLab, you'll help build a dedicated software supply chain security feature for regulated enterprise organizations. In this role, you'll contribute to capabilities that help customers control software dependencies, verify artifact integrity, and identify malicious packages before they reach production.

Your work will sit at the intersection of backend engineering, product integration, and security-focused development.
